0022600103.text: The Trail Blazers, 1-0 and first in the Northwest and the West, visit the 0-1 Sacramento Kings, who are fourth in the Pacific, one game back, and 14th in the West, in Portland's second game of the season. Portland is without Branden Carlson (concussion), Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness), and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (ruptured Achilles), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Malik Monk is day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision. Portland won the last meeting 122-110 in Portland on April 12, 2026, and took the 2025-26 season series 4-0, with no games between the teams yet in 2026-27.
